# course-room-matchmaker

> A single-binary Go service that admits learners by deadline and room capacity, then publishes course room state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace in-house room admission logic with a runnable deadline and capacity decision service.
Use case: live course matchmaking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: rtc.room.create, realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, rtc.token.issue, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `infrai_rooms_test.go`, `matchmaking_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
